🚨🇲🇽 <u>AYOTZINAPA: FORMER GUERRERO GOVERNOR JAILED OVER HIDDEN VIDEOS</u>

Ángel Aguirre Rivero woke up in El Altiplano today. The FGR says the Estrella de Oro bus 1531 carrying the 43 students was videotaped by cameras 12 and 15 outside Iguala’s Palacio de Justicia as municipal and state police detained them — footage officials claimed for years "did not exist due to technical failures." That version was false. In January a collaborator revealed who extracted the recordings and delivered them directly to the then-governor. Sheinbaum this morning: the detention "is not a political matter," but the result of months of prosecutorial work, including phone-evidence analysis. Twelve years later, the "historical truth" keeps collapsing.

🇲🇽📉 <u>INFLATION FALLS TO 3.12% — LOWEST JULY IN A DECADE</u>

INEGI reported July inflation at 3.12% annually, the lowest reading for a month of July in ten years, with the consumer price index barely moving 0.03% in the month. Sheinbaum called it "good news" this morning. The figure lands a day after Banxico held its rate at 6.5% in a second straight pause, projecting even lower inflation ahead. Mexico’s prices keep cooling while the peso trades at its strongest levels of the year.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO AND PERU RESTORE DIPLOMATIC TIES AFTER 9-MONTH RUPTURE</u>

Mexico and Peru agreed today to resume diplomatic relations, citing the "historic bonds of brotherhood, friendship and cooperation" between the two countries. Lima broke ties in November 2025 after Mexico granted asylum to former prime minister Betssy Chávez — a decision Mexico always defended as legitimate under international law. Mexico never broke the relationship; Peru did. Now Chávez has her safe-conduct and is already traveling to Mexico, foreign minister Velasco has spoken with his Peruvian counterpart Carlos Espá, and Keiko Fujimori says she will name an ambassador to Mexico in the coming days.

‍LATIN TIMES: Mexican migrant with leukemia dies in ICE custody as family alleges medical negligence August 6, 2026 | 🟢 📰 José Guadalupe Ramos Solano died after being found unresponsive at the Adelanto ICE Processing Center in California. His family says repeated requests for care were ignored. Mexico says he is the 17th Mexican to die in ICE custody or enforcement operations since Trump returned — and has asked US attorneys general and the DOJ to investigate. • "found unconscious and unresponsive in his housing unit" • "an unprecedented legal effort"

‍AP: More than a decade after 43 students vanished in Mexico, ex-governor arrested, accused of cover-up August 6, 2026 | 🟢 📰 Former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre was arrested, accused of ordering security footage of the 2014 Ayotzinapa attacks destroyed. AP quotes the attorney general, a human rights center, and a victim's father — straight reporting. One tell: his party is called "a party that gave rise to Mexico's ruling Morena party." It has a name: the PRD. Prosecutors credit Sheinbaum's reopened investigation for the arrest; only bone fragments of 3 of the 43 students have ever been found. • "a malicious operation, deliberately orchestrated from the highest levels" • "He has to tell everything he knows"

‍SEMAFOR: Mexico's Sheinbaum rules out fracking expansion August 6, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Sheinbaum banned fracking in a key basin, citing water tables and indigenous communities. Semafor's read: she "backtracked on her opposition to fracking," a president it describes as "alternatingly defied and placated Washington" — zero sources quoted in the entire piece. The basin is never named and the decision is reduced to a "political balancing act" toward Washington — the environmental rationale is quoted only to be reframed. • "backtracked on her opposition to fracking" • "alternatingly defied and placated Washington"
banner: Sheinbaum bans fracking in key basin

text: ‍THE INDEPENDENT: A cartel stronghold just put America's avocado supply at risk August 6, 2026 | 🔴 📰 The Independent turned a preventive pause of US inspections in Michoacán into a "cartel stronghold" putting "America's avocado supply at risk" 🔍 Its own body admits officials knew of no direct threats against inspectors and called the troop deployment a precaution. Mexico sent 1,500 additional troops to Michoacán; past inspection pauses (2022, 2024) were resolved within days. • "a 'threat to U.S. interests' that could disrupt shipments to American consumers" • "long been plagued by organized crime"

‍REUTERS: Peru and Mexico Resume Diplomatic Relations After Dispute Over Leftist Politician August 7, 2026 | 🟢 📰 Mexico and Peru restored full diplomatic relations after Lima gave safe passage to Betssy Chávez, the former PM Mexico had granted asylum. Reuters ran it straight — including that Peru's Congress voted to declare Sheinbaum persona non grata. One gap: every official quoted is Peruvian; no Mexican government voice appears. Chávez arrived in Mexico Thursday night "in good health"; Keiko Fujimori had announced the restoration before taking office last week. • "declare Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum a 'persona non grata'" • "left the country almost at midnight on Thursday for Mexico in 'good health'"

🇲🇽🏭 <u>AI DATA CENTER BOOM HAS NUEVO LEÓN RUNNING AT FULL CAPACITY</u>

The AI boom is landing in Mexico's industrial heartland. Demand for data center cooling systems has Nuevo León manufacturers with their production committed for the next two years, El Financiero reports — and every company in the sector is expanding.

The North American cooling market is set to jump from $50 to $75 billion in three years. Nuevo León — 345 companies, 35,000 jobs and 40% of Mexico's appliance exports worth $4.2 billion — is built to capture it. Under the T-MEC's rules of origin, the boom feeds Mexican supply chains.
banner: AI BOOM: NUEVO LEÓN AT FULL CAPACITY

🇲🇽🥇 <u>MEXICO SMASHES ALL-TIME GOLD RECORD AT CENTRAL AMERICAN GAMES</u>

Mexico just posted the best gold medal harvest in its Central American and Caribbean Games history: 152 golds in Santo Domingo, blowing past the previous record of 145 set in San Salvador.

With 346 total medals — 101 silver, 99 bronze — the delegation sits alone atop the medal table, just two medals short of the all-time total record. The record-breaking 146th gold came in modern pentathlon; distance runner Laura Galván closed out the 10,000m in 34:26.06. Regional hegemony, they call it. They're not wrong.
